elements.description: แปลนชั้นล่าง บันได ST.2 — THIS is the main interior stair connecting ground floor (+0.60) to upper floor (+3.75), matching the switchback stair drawn in section on หน้า15's รูปตัด 3. Ground-floor-plan cut shows the first flight, treads 1-9 (numbered right-to-left, 'ขึ้น' up-arrow pointing left), with a diagonal winder/turn line near tread 9 marking where the flight turns at the landing toward the return flight (continues on the upper-floor-plan view).
เก็บของ (storage under/beside the stair) — exact match to หน้า15's เก็บของ_cut (same printed_as '4 +0.60 5')
โถง (ground-floor hall) at the foot of the stair — matches หน้า15/18/19's โถง_ชั้น1_cut exactly

Two independent chains from the same left wall, not required to reconcile with each other (different purposes): (a) overall enclosure — 1.10 + 2.35 + 1.15 = 4.60 (wall-to-wall incl. เก็บของ/door zone); (b) stair-tread-focused — 1.10 + 2.25 + 1.05 = 4.40 (tread run zone only, 9 treads @ 0.25m). Both start flush at the same left wall (offset 1.10 from it to grid '1').
Multiple small hollow-triangle callouts, all reading '1' — same unresolved wall-finish code family as elsewhere in this house's architecture set

warnings: GRID CONFIRMATION (positive, no conflict): grid D-to-C = 2.20m and grid1-to-2 = 3.50m both match the grid master exactly — same bay pattern as หน้า20's ST.1 sheet, further reinforcing the master's reliability on this house.

This is the MAIN INTERIOR STAIR (previously only seen unmarked in section on หน้า15's รูปตัด 3, which itself flagged 'no printed mark ST# on this sheet' — this page (A-19) supplies that mark: ST.2). Distinct from หน้า20's ST.1, which is a short exterior entrance stair in a completely different location (grid A-B, not D-C).

One of 2 views on this sheet; sibling is the upper-floor plan _view2_st2_floor2_plan.json — no section view is included on THIS sheet (unlike ST.1's combined plan+section sheet); a dedicated ST.2 section, if one exists, was not found within this assignment's page range and may be on a page outside it.
เก็บของ and โถง room-label boxes both exactly match their respective หน้า15 room_cut entries — strong cross-page confirmation, no new conflicts.

The two independent dimension chains (4.60 overall vs 4.40 tread-focused) are NOT a conflict — they measure different extents from the same reference wall, a normal stair-drawing convention (overall enclosure vs. the tread run itself, which stops short of the far wall at a landing).
